Appearance:
 Shri Sourabh Bhushan Shrivastava - Advocate for the a  Shri C.M.Tiwari - G.A. appearing on behalf of respond  Shri Shivam Prajapati - Advocate for Objector.
 ORDER
This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in jail since 18.09.2025 in connection with Crime No.422 of 2025 registered at P.S. Kotwali Raisen District-Raisen for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 468, 467,
471 and 120(B) of the IPC.

3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant, who was working as Agent at the Raisen Branch of Shriram Finance Company Private Limited, submitted loan applications in the names of Rajaram,
Pramod and Dolly using his official company ID.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 18.09.2025.
No custodial interrogation is required.
Case is triable by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:56019 2 MCRC-45034-2025 JMFC.
It is also urged that co-accused Rajaram and Pramod have already deposited the loan amount and they have been issued NOC by the Shriram Finance Company Private Limited.
So far as, Dolly's loan amount is concerned, applicant is ready to deposit remaining loan installments.

Therefore, no useful purpose would be served by keeping the applicant behind the Rajkumar Lodhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88642063/
1 bar.

sentences.text: On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the application.
6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail and accordingly, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that subject to depositing remaining loan amount of Dolly's before the trial Court,
the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/-
(Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:56019 3 MCRC-45034-2025 9.
M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
